notes.title: Predators Rework - Update v1.0.13
notes.content:
Update v1.0.13 introduces a change to how predators function in the game.

[h2]What’s Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bear caves and wolf dens removed: [/b]Predators will no longer spawn from static locations on the map. Instead, like raiders, they will attack the village at set intervals from outside the map.

[*] [b]Predator Attacks: [/b]Wolves and bears will now attack the village periodically. For the first 3 years, villages will be protected from these attacks. After that, attacks will occur every 2-4 years. However, these attacks can be completely prevented. if the village is fully surrounded by walls, predator attacks will cease entirely.
[/list]
[h2]Why This Change?[/h2]
Previously, bear caves and wolf dens spawned in specific locations on the map. If players destroyed them, predator attacks would stop permanently. If no caves or dens were near the settlement, wolves and bears would never attack, even after many hours of gameplay. Additionally, when raider invasions were disabled in the settings, walls became nearly useless.

With this update, predator attacks function similarly to raider attacks. This ensures that they occur more consistently, making them a guaranteed event in every game. It also preserves the importance of building walls, even in games where raiders are disabled. Furthermore, this change prevents players from being forced to settle in inefficient locations just to avoid predator spawn points.

In the previous version, if players disabled bear caves and wolf dens while creating a new game, they couldn’t enable them later. Now, in this new version, players can enable predator attacks at any time, even if they were initially turned off.

I guess that some players may have found bear caves and wolf dens more meaningful. In the future, I might consider a balanced system that includes both static spawn points and periodic predator events.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
Apart from hotfixes, future updates will focus on mostly new content. My primary focus for the next update is bridges. Unless an urgent issue or request comes up, I plan to introduce bridges to the game.

See you in the next update, enjoy the game!

notes.title: V1.0.12 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
The V1.0.12 hotfix includes several adjustments to dung haulers introduced in the previous update. Based on community feedback, I agreed that accessing fertilizer in the early game could be challenging. Therefore, the following changes have been made to dung haulers and waste management:

[list]
[*] Fertilizer production speed increased by 25%.
[*] Dung hauler cart capacity has been halved, making dung haulers empty their loads into the fertilizer pit more frequently.
[*] If there is no fertilizer in storage, dung haulers will no longer wait for their carts to be full. Instead, they will transport the first collected waste directly to the fertilizer pit.
[*] Instead of waiting for waste to accumulate up to 10, households will now dispose of waste once it reaches 5. This will introduce waste into the game earlier.
[/list]

notes.title: Waste Collectors Rework - Update v1.0.11
notes.content:
The v1.0.11 update is a small patch that reworks the functionality of waste collectors and fixes several bugs.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dung Haulers: [/b]Waste collectors are now called dung haulers. They no longer work directly at the fertilizer pit. Instead, waste accumulated in houses and livestock buildings is now collected by the villagers in buckets and taken to the nearest fertilizer pit or, if available, to dung hauler carts. Once a dung hauler cart is full, a dung hauler will transport it to the fertilizer pit. Even if there are no dung hauler carts in the village, waste can still be carried directly to the fertilizer pit, but placing dung hauler carts at key locations will prevent villagers from having to walk long distances. Dung hauler carts do not require any resources or construction to be placed, and each cart can be managed by one dung hauler. Dung hauler carts don't affect landvalues. This change was made to prevent waste collectors from getting stuck when traveling long distances in the late game and to add an intermediary element to deepen this mechanic.

[*] [b]Cloud Save: [/b]Steam Auto-Cloud has been enabled. Since this is my first time using this system, I hope game saves sync without any issues.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Saving/Loading the game has been disabled in the demo.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare issue where a fully repaired ship would not launch into the water.
[*] Fixed an issue where one of the fiber growth speed enhancement cards displayed "greens" instead of "fiber."
[*] Fixed a bug where villagers could get stuck in a "pick up food → fail → retry" loop when retrieving food from a distant location. These types of issues are usually caused by navigation errors.
[/list]

Before moving on to new content, there will be one more small update focused on refinements and adjustments.

Enjoy the game, everyone.

notes.title: Cheats - V1.0.10 Update notes
notes.content:
The V1.0.10 update introduces a cheat system for those who want to play the game in sandbox mode. Additionally, it includes changes to how the marketplace functions.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Cheats: [/b]A cheat panel has been added to the game. To use cheats, you must enable them in the game settings. Once cheats are enabled in a save, you will no longer be able to earn achievements in that save, and cheats cannot be disabled again. You can open the cheat menu by pressing F6. Available cheats include adding/removing resources, adding/removing people, adding/removing animals, supplying resources to all constructions and completing them, removing the Fog of War, and triggering disasters like earthquakes, raids, plagues, and fires.
[/list]

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bazaar rework: [/b]Bazaar no longer generate gold. In the late game, gold is already easy to obtain, and the bazaar had little impact on gameplay aside from increasing land value. Instead, bazaar now automatically supply resources to houses within their influence area. Houses within the blue-marked radius will receive essential supplies like food and firewood directly from the bazaar. This means villagers will no longer have to leave their jobs to transport these resources, improving overall productivity.

[*] [b]Gold Economy Adjustments:[/b] Since markets no longer generate gold, gold rewards from exploration missions have been doubled. Traders now carry more gold. The trade price range has been increased from 50% to 80%, making it more profitable to buy low and sell high. Gold production from gold ore has been increased; one stack of gold ore now produces 18 gold instead of 12.

[*] [b]Mission & Raid Adjustments:[/b] The chance for the Immigrant Ship event to appear has been increased. The minimum success rate for Treasure Hunt missions has been improved. Raiders' carrying capacity has been reduced by 50%.
[/list]

If you feel that these changes affect game balance too much or if you encounter any new bugs, please continue reporting them. Enjoy the game!

notes.content:
Version 1.0.7 is a minor update that introduces small changes and fixes a few bugs.

[list]
[*] 3 New Resources Added: Pants, Dresses, and Shirts. These resources are produced in the Textile Workshop. Instead of a generic "Clothes," these new items were introduced. Dresses are exclusively worn by women, while Pants and Shirts are only worn by men. Their effects remain the same as the old Clothes. The new Pants and Shirts resources will also apply to your saved games. If you have a large population in your village, be aware that villagers will immediately start demanding Pants and Shirts.
[*] Hide Coat Renamed to Winter Cloak: The name was changed to better fit the visuals, as villagers wear cloak-like clothing during winter.
[*] Shoes Renamed to Leather Boots: Since villagers wear boots, and this equipment provides protection against the cold during winter, "Leather Boots" was deemed a more accurate name.
[*] Cobblers Workshop Renamed to Leatherworks: This building now produces both Leather Boots and Winter Cloaks. Previously, Hide Coats were produced in the Weavers Hut. With this change, both buildings now use a single type of input resource, improving efficiency.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with population enhancement cards.
[*] Corrected several translation errors where Japanese text appeared as Korean.
[/list]

Adding new resources may introduce new bugs. If you encounter anything broken or feel that the balance is not good, please let me know.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update Notes
notes.content:
The v1.0.5 update is a minor patch that introduces a few small changes and fixes some bugs in the game.

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]

[list]
[*] The maximum production limit of 9999 has been removed. Previously, when gold exceeded 9999, the smeltery would stop producing gold. Now, production can continue beyond this limit.
[*] The initial builder capacity has been increased from 10 to 50. This change was necessary to allow for faster rebuilding of structures destroyed by earthquakes in the late game. In the future, this capacity may be increased further with a building like a Builder's Guild.
[*] The initial laborer capacity has been increased from 30 to 100. This change was made due to a high workload and a low number of laborers in the late game. Initially, the laborer limit was set at 30 to optimize CPU performance, but since no performance issues have been reported, the limit has now been raised. In the future, a building such as a Laborers' Guild may be introduced to further increase laborer capacity.
[*] The worker capacity at the trading dock has been increased from 2 to 5.
[*] Shift-click functionality has been added to the profession list menu, allowing workers to be assigned or removed in increments of 10.
[*] The impact of small earthquakes remains unchanged, but the destructive power of large earthquakes has been slightly reduced.
[*] Some building names have been revised to make them clearer for non-native English speakers and to prevent confusion with upcoming production buildings.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the gravedigger could get stuck in an infinite loop inside the cemetery.
[*] Fixed a bug where the prices of wine and beer in the trader could exceed the min-max limits, which could result in negative values and cause a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where enhancement cards that were supposed to increase the capacity of the Healer's Hut were mistakenly providing a healing speed boost instead.
[*] Fixed a rare crash caused by a code issue related to ship movement calculations.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Settlements Rising - Full Release Announcement!
notes.content:
Greetings eveyone,

I am thrilled to announce that Settlements Rising has officially left Early Access and is now available as a full release! This marks a major milestone for the game, and I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you who supported the game throughout the Early Access journey.

[h2]What Does Full Release Mean?[/h2]

While the game has now reached v1.0.0, this does not mean that updates are coming to an end. The Early Access roadmap has been successfully completed, bringing all the planned features to life. However, development will continue. Moving forward, updates will primarily focus on bug fixes, balance improvements, and quality of life enhancements to ensure the best possible experience for you.

[h2]What About New Content?[/h2]

Although future updates will prioritize stability and refinements, new content may still be added from time to time. The frequency of such updates will slow down compared to the Early Access period.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2]

I encourage you to continue sharing your bug reports and feedback, as they are valuable to me. Every piece of feedback is read with care, and many of the UI tools and features you see in the game today were inspired by player suggestions. Your input has shaped Settlements Rising into what it is today, and I hope you'll continue to be part of its journey.

Developing this game as a solo developer has been a time-consuming process that required many sacrifices from my social life. However, seeing the game being appreciated and receiving your feedback has made it all worthwhile.

Thank you once again for being an essential part of the community. Enjoy the full release, and happy building!

notes.title: Settlements Rising: 1.0 Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope 2025 has started wonderfully for you all. I'm thrilled to announce that we are participating in the Steam Real-Time Strategy Fest, which will run from January 20th to January 27th, and during this event, the game will officially release version 1.0 on January 20th.

We've made great progress in completing the game's roadmap in a short time, and with the feedback I've received from all of you, I've added even more to the game. I'm very satisfied with where we've arrived. To give you access to version 1.0, I've created a beta branch on Steam called "1.0 Preview". Through this branch, you can play the upcoming version before its official release.

Moving to version 1.0 does not mean the end of support or updates for the game. However, updates may come less frequently, focusing on improving user experience, fixing bugs, balancing gameplay, and adding quality-of-life updates.

[h1]Update Notes for 1.0 Preview:[/h1]
[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/8eea2bf2e7c69a98533f687c1e7c8d1d97d20147.png[/img]

notes.title: Disasters - Update V0.6.8 Update Notes
notes.content:
The V0.6.8 update introduces the Plague and Earthquake disasters to the game.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/f3e727e09f7c2ba8cd9b7081ec61ec2337479f5b.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Earthquake: E[/b]arthquakes occur every 10-15 years by default, with magnitudes ranging between 6 and 7.5 Mw. They strike randomly and damage buildings in the affected area. The earthquake's magnitude determines the level of damage and the size of the impact zone. Villagers inside collapsed buildings have roughly a 50% chance of either dying or getting injured. Damaged buildings are repaired by builders without requiring additional resources.

[*] [b]Plague: [/b]The plague outbreak occurs roughly every 10-15 years by default. It starts by infecting a few villagers and spreads to others in their homes and workplaces. As a result, its spread is highly random. Generally, the plague can infect between one-third and half of the population, with approximately 10% of the adult population dying on average. Villagers affected by the plague will slowly lose health. However, villagers receiving treatment at the Healer's Hut will not lose health. Similarly, military units behave as if they are receiving treatment. Plague-infected villagers cannot work, causing a loss in workforce productivity.

[*] [b]Polish Translation:[/b] Thanks to the efforts of our friend [b]Damian Bartyś (Lisek)[/b], the Polish translation has been added to the game. We hope our Polish players will enjoy the game even more now!
[/list]

This update marks the final content update leading up to the full version of the game. The next update will focus on introducing winter clothing for villagers and improving mountain models, alongside visual enhancements.

Wishing everyone a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Decorations - V0.6.7 Update Notes
notes.content:
The V0.6.7 update introduces decorations, pigs, and a few improvements to the game.

[h3]What’s New?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Pigs: [/b]Pigs have been added to the game for livestock farming. Unlike other livestock, pigs do not produce resources continuously. They are raised and slaughtered to produce meat and leather. Pigs provide a moderate amount of both meat and leather.

[*] [b]Restricting Production Building Storage for Personal Use: [/b]You can now choose to restrict production building storages from being accessed directly by villagers for personal use. Villagers typically search for food and equipment at the nearest production building or storage. If you want the equipment in a production building to only be accessible through dedicated storages or marketplaces, you can disable personal access to those storages.
[/list]

[h3]New Decorations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/ca5362f93c95818416e93ff81320de8b04c8b821.jpg[/img]
Small decorative objects that are not tied to tiling have been added. Unlike other decorations, these do not require construction or resources and have no impact on land value. New decorations include:
[list]
[*] Bench
[*] Flowers
[*] Stepping stones
[*] Street signs
[*] Crates and barrels
[*] Street lamps
[*] Wheelbarrows and carts
[*] Buckets and bins
[*] Trees
[*] Fence
[/list]
Among these, only trees need to be planted by workers and will grow over time. These decorative trees can later be cut down to produce wood.

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
The minimum happiness threshold required for immigrants to consider joining the village in the mid-game has been lowered. The range has changed from 60%-90%, depending on population, to 45%-85%.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
A few formatting issues in enhancement card descriptions have been fixed.

See you in future updates.

notes.title: Bathhouse - V0.6.5 Update Notes
notes.content:
The v0.6.5 update introduces a new type of service building: the Bathhouse.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/cbcdbbbf8adf6e0c171c9d9df062336007dfbbe3.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Bathhouse:[/b] The Bathhouse is a relaxation building where bathkeepers work. This building fulfills villagers' rest and warmth needs while also increasing land value over a wide area. To function efficiently, the Bathhouse requires firewood and water. Villagers recover faster in the Bathhouse compared to resting at home or in parks.

[*] [b]Bathkeeper: [/b]Bathkeepers work at the Bathhouse and are responsible for providing the firewood and water the building requires. Additionally, the ratio of bathkeepers to resting villagers affects how quickly villagers recover.
[/list]

When villagers leave work, they look for the nearest park or Bathhouse and choose the most suitable resting spot based on their home's distance. If the villager's home is significantly closer than the nearest park or Bathhouse, they will prefer to rest at home. Since villagers refill their inventory with food stored at home when they visit, going home can sometimes be more efficient.

See you in the next updates!

notes.title: Orchard - V0.64 Update Notes
notes.content:
The V0.64 update introduces the Fruits food type and the Orchard structure to the game, along with several bug fixes and new features.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/001e883f83d2c1355d877a18c8efaa3fa01c17a9.png[/img]
[*] [b]Orchard:[/b] In Orchards, orchardists plant and grow fruit trees. The planted trees start bearing fruit after approximately 1 in-game year and reach full maturity in about 3 in-game years. Fruit trees require water and fertilizer to grow effectively. While rainy weather can fulfill their water needs, a Compost Yard must be built to meet the fertilizer requirements. Without adequate water and fertilizer, trees grow slower and produce less fruit. Unlike Crop Fields, Orchards provide food production throughout the year.

[*] [b]Orchardist:[/b] Orchardists work in the Orchard, handling the planting, maintenance, and harvesting of fruit trees. Their experience gain rate and training requirements are comparable to those of Field Farmers. Depending on the size of an Orchard, up to 9 Orchardists can work there at maximum capacity.

[*] [b]Fruits:[/b] A food type with a shelf life of 500 days. In future updates, Fruits will also serve as a raw material for producing Cider.

[*] New enhancement cards: A total of 8 new enhancement cards related to fruits and orchards have been added.

[*] [b]Animal Sales in Neighboring Villages: [/b]Neighboring villages now sell cows, sheep, and chickens. The chance for a village to sell animals in a given cycle is 33%.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Trading Ships awaiting cargo loading for trade would get stuck in the cargo loading task after loading a saved game.
[/list]

See you in future updates!

notes.title: Paper and Books - Update Notes V0.6.3
notes.content:
The V0.6.3 update introduces two production buildings and two new resources that impact education. Additionally, it includes several fixes and improvements.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/fa91916628ba8234080ede0126fed458aed01b41.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Papermill:[/b] A new production building that produces paper from fiber. Up to 5 paper makers can work here.
[*] [b]Paper Maker:[/b] Workers in the papermill who produce paper.
[*] [b]Paper:[/b] A new resource used in book production. Building a papermill is required to produce paper.
[*] [b]Scriptorium:[/b] A place where books are crafted using paper and leather. Up to 4 scribes can work here to produce books for school use.
[*] [b]Scribe:[/b] Works in the scriptorium, using 3 units of paper and 1 unit of leather to produce books. Training is more crucial for scribes than for other professions in terms of skill and experience gain.
[*] [b]Books:[/b] Produced in the scriptorium and used in schools to boost education speed by 30%.
[*][b] New Enhancement Cards:[/b] 16 new enhancement cards related to paper, books, and their production have been added.
[*] [b]Infinite Ore Deposits Setting: [/b]An option for players who don't want ore deposits to run out. This setting can also be changed in your existing saved games.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased education speed in schools.
[*] Increased leather production speed by 40% due to additional uses for leather.
[*] Decreased wool production speed by 50% due to overproduction.
[*] Decreased animal hide production speed by 30% due to overproduction.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an automatic fix to prevent raiders from getting stuck in mountains.
[*] Fixed an issue where villagers wouldn’t return to their daily routines after fleeing raiders and entering their homes.
[/list]

See you in future updates!

notes.title: Pickle Workshop - V0.6.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
The v0.6.2 update brings several new features to the game, including pickles, a pickle workshop, and the ability to change game settings mid-game.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Change Game Settings:[/b] I value the time players invest in the game, and to show respect for their time, I aim to remove the need for starting a new game to change certain game settings. If you're unhappy with a setting in your current game, you can now modify it without beginning anew. Gameplay settings like fog of war, enhancement cards, raids, fires, and production speed can now be adjusted in existing games. However, world generation settings, which are applied at the start of a game, remain unchangeable after that point. When a setting is modified, the game saves with the new configuration and reloads, ensuring the changes take effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/de09f54e0654364d75f7058d04f4c10f83e3e05a.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Pickle Workshop:[/b] To extend the shelf life of greens and produce an alternative food source, a new building has been added that transforms greens into pickles. In the pickle workshop, three picklers transform 1 unit of greens into 2 units of pickles. While greens have a shelf life of 420 days, pickles last for 850 days.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
The algorithm that helps villagers move closer to their workplaces has been optimized for better efficiency in the late game.

See you in future updates!

notes.title: V0.6.1 hotfix notes
notes.content: V0.6.1 hotfix update is an update that fixes the bug where the woodcutter produces a maximum of 80 firewood as a result of the wood dropping from 2.5 unit weight to 1.0 unit weight in the update that came during the day.

notes.title: Selective Storage - v0.6.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
The v0.6.0 update introduces a new type of storage and brings several improvements to the game.

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/10187ff9fed9696760388961ca8ba3329f16b6d5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Selective Storage: [/b]Selective storage has a lower capacity compared to open storage. However, it employs one storage attendant who transports the selected resources to the storage using a wheelcart. This feature makes it ideal for placing near production buildings that are far from main storage areas, preventing workers from traveling long distances to fetch resources, thereby improving productivity.

Only the resources you select from the resource list will be stored in selective storage. When choosing resources, you will have the option to enable auto-transport. Resources with auto-transport enabled will be automatically transported to this storage, while resources without auto-transport will only be stored if nearby villagers manually deposit them.

[*][b] Storage Attendant:[/b] The storage attendant works in selective storage, ensuring that the resources with auto-transport enabled are consistently available in the storage. Additionally, the attendant transfers excess resources from selective storage to open storage to free up space when the local storage limit is exceeded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/19421b0f089e74aa2a47cbbf1c66e7b20714096c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Stored Item Hover Info: [/b]A new hover tooltip has been added that provides more detailed information when you hover over resources in storages. The tooltip shows unit weight, the percentage of space the resource occupies, and the total capacity of the storage.
[/list]

[h2]Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The unit weight of firewood has been reduced from 2.5 to 1.0.
[*] Improvements have been made to optimize resource sharing in storages, ensuring that villagers have better access to the resources they need simultaneously.
[/list]


Unless plans change, the next content update will introduce paper and book production, with books serving as a booster in education. Additionally, a new algorithm is in development to improve late-game productivity by carefully calculating the distance between villagers' homes and workplaces, ensuring more efficient household assignments. However, these plans may adapt based on feedback and needs.

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Beta v0.5.12 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
The v0.5.12 hotfix addresses several issues in the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare scenario where loading a saved game could cause the game to crash within a few minutes due to a livestock bug.
[*] Fixed a bug where fire visuals were missing when the tannery, weaponsmith, or armorsmith buildings caught fire.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tannery’s negative land value impact was not being displayed.
[/list]

I’m getting close to finishing the next content update. However, I didn’t want to wait a few more days due to concerns over the loading crash issue, so I decided to release this hotfix. I expect to release a new content update, along with a few improvements, within the next few days.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: v0.5.11 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
The v0.5.11 hotfix is a small update aimed at addressing two bugs in the game.

[list]
[*] I received reports of some late-game saves getting stuck on the loading screen. Normally, loading a saved game takes about 5-10 seconds. If it takes 30+ seconds, a new system has been added that allows you to force-skip the loading screen. I haven't identified the root cause of this issue yet, but I implemented this time limit so you can continue playing. If anyone encounters this situation with their save, could you please test it and let me know if everything works correctly? Since it’s a forced skip of the loading screen, some elements may not load properly, such as grass or terrain. I would appreciate your feedback on this.

[*] Fixed a pathfinding issue that caused ships arriving from outside the map to get stuck at the map boundary on large maps.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta v0.5.10 Hotfix Update Notes
notes.content:
The v0.5.10 update is a minor patch that addresses a few issues.

[list]
[*] A bug introduced in the previous update caused trading dock workers to get stuck when picking up goods directly from crop fields. This issue has been fixed.
[*] The issue where villager information was missing from cemetery texts in the Spanish localization has been corrected.
[*] A bug where foresters would become idle due to being too far from their workplace has been resolved.
[*] The caching algorithm has been improved to reduce crashes related to Async path tests on certain hardwares. If you experience these crashes, feedback on whether this update improves or worsens the situation would be greatly appreciated.
[/list]

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese Update - Beta v0.5.9 small update notes
notes.content:
Beta v0.5.9 Update is a small update that adds Brazilian Portuguese to the game and includes a few changes.

[list]
[*] Brazilian Portuguese has been added. Special thanks to [b]MaduJoga, Cezar Pezzotti, and Arthur Bottacin Cambler[/b] for their translation work.
[*] The maximum number of laborers has been increased from 20 to 30.
[*] The maximum number of builders has been increased from 5 to 10.
[*] The direct use of resources being harvested from fields has been enabled. In the previous version, all products had to be harvested and stored before they could be used. Now, production buildings and villagers in need of food can go directly to the field and collect resources as soon as harvesting begins. This prevents villagers from starving during shortages even when food is available in the fields.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.8 Hotfix Update
notes.content:
The v0.5.8 hotfix is a small update aimed at preventing a specific issue in the game. During the late game, food packages dropped on the ground could cause a bug where a spoiled item would prevent the resources from being collected.

This issue could block laborers' workflow, leading to reduced efficiency and accumulation of uncollected resources on the ground.

To address this, an algorithm has been implemented to monitor food spoilage, along with a system that automatically stores any dropped resources in the nearest storage if they are not collected within 10 minutes.

notes.title: Personalities and Path Visualizer - V0.5.7 Update Notes
notes.content:
v0.5.7 introduces two important features to the game: Villager traits and the path visualizer. Villager traits give villagers advantages or disadvantages in specific areas, while the path visualizer draws a navigation line to show where selected villagers are heading.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Villager traits:[/b] A total of 23 villager traits have been added. These are: Hardworking, lazy, optimistic, pessimistic, quick learner, slow learner, brave, coward, resilient, fragile, organized, disorganized, nature lover, nature hater, craftsman, clumsy, sharpshooter, enduring, easily fatigued, cold resistant, cold sensitive, cautious, careless. You can learn the descriptions of these traits by hovering over them in the villager profiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/e1acdab5e5561bd575d3725c1cfbba8b0517c1f3.jpg[/img]
[*][b] Assigning and reassigning workers: [/b]With the addition of villager traits, you may want to assign certain villagers to work in specific buildings based on their traits. Worker assignment and replacement buttons have now been added to the building interfaces. With these buttons, you can search for idle or working villagers by name or trait and assign them to the relevant building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/e3894d583ce6dba16ba36b9e1262ab0913892c52.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Path visualizer: [/b]When you select villagers, click on a building, or hover over a resource on the ground, a navigation line is drawn to the point where the selected villagers are heading. This lets you know where the villager is going. These lines can be activated in several ways:

-For selected villagers, whether single or multiple.
-For workers assigned to a building under construction when the building is selected.
-For villagers in a specific profession when selecting all assigned workers from the professions list.
-For workers assigned to production buildings when the building is selected.
-For villagers assigned to gather resources when hovering over resources waiting to be collected.

These lines can be toggled on or off via the interface.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Villagers can now automatically consume dropped food on the ground when there is no food in storage and none in their inventory, but dropped food is available. Dropped food is included in the total food supply, and the remaining months of food are calculated accordingly. In previous version, villagers would die of starvation even though the UI indicated that there was food left because the food shown in the UI was waiting to be collected. This adjustment resolves the confusion where food was displayed, but villagers were starving.

[*] To prevent overproduction of arrows, the number of arrows produced from 1 wood has been reduced from 8 to 6.

[*] When villagers are dismissed from a job, a replacement will be assigned immediately.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where leathers were not visible in the interfaces or trade.
[*] Fixed the bug where accepting raiders' request in the first raids would grant the "Flawless Defense" achievement.
[*] Fixed the issue where the "Paved Road" achievement would only work after loading a saved game, but not when the first stone road was built.
[*] Similarly, fixed the issue where the "Shipwright's Bride" achievement only triggered after loading a game, not when the first ship was constructed.
[*] Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when loading the game. This issue was caused by the waste collector trying to pathfind before caching algorithm.
[*] Fixed the issue where villagers would get stuck in a loop between idle and stock food tasks when food was limited in storage and many houses were waiting for food.
[*] Fixed the issue where gold in the market was not being transferred to storage.
[*] Fixed the issue where waste collectors, when traveling far from their workplace, would cancel their task and fail to return the wheelbarrow to the workplace.
[*] Fixed the empty row appearing in the construction queue when walls were being built or repaired. This row now correctly displays "Walls" for wall construction or repair.
[*] Fixed the issue where villagers experienced difficulties equipping items after long play sessions.
[*] Fixed errors in the Korean translations of resource names.
[*] Added a setting to adjust the amount of fires during the demo save conversion when transitioning from the demo to Early Access.
[/list]

With this update, the demo has been updated to version v1.0.36. The population limit has been reduced from 50 to 40 in the demo, and trade, agriculture, animal husbandry, decorations, and forestry have been locked. This reduces the demo's gameplay time to between 45 and 60 minutes.

See you in future updates!

notes.title: Beta v0.5.6 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
The v0.5.6 update addresses several bugs in the game, and some improvements were also made to the French localization.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the gatherer building would take 1-2 minutes to detect resources after loading the game.
[*] Corrected two code errors in the enhancement card descriptions in the German localization.
[*] Resolved a bug where the total number of extinguished fires was not being properly saved. This made obtaining the "Inferno Tamer" achievement much more difficult.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would zoom in and out unexpectedly when the game was not in focus or the FPS was insufficient.
[*] Resolved the inability to build a road on tiles with deer spawners. The road can now be built over these points without deleting the spawner.
[*] The fire risk for wall gates and defense towers has been disabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where some players using 4K resolution experienced an offset between the cursor and the building when placing objects.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta v0.5.5 Hotfix
notes.content: This hotfix addresses an issue where the Town Center UI would not open when enhancement cards were disabled, preventing it from being upgraded to level 2 in a new game. Additionally, a typo in the neighbor trading UI has been corrected.

notes.title: Beta v0.5.4 Hotfix
notes.content: The v0.5.4 hotfix aims to resolve the cursor offset bug in the game. I received 2-3 bug reports about an offset between the cursor and the tile being placed. From now on, when calculating the ground location beneath the cursor, the engine cursor location will be used instead of the hardware cursor. Players who haven’t experienced this issue won’t notice any difference. If those who have encountered the cursor offset issue continue to experience it, they can try adjusting the game's screen resolution and fullscreen mode settings.

notes.title: Beta v0.5.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
The v0.5.3 hotfix update fixes a critical bug that needed urgent attention. 

When villagers search for resources, they select the nearest storage from the ones they can reach via pathfinding. In the late game, due to an error in the code written to optimize the pathfinding algorithm, they started selecting the first accessible storage they found instead of the closest one. 

While this bug did not break the game, it could cause villagers to go to a distant water well in case of a fire etc. This update fixes that issue.

notes.title: Hardware Cursor Update - The Demo v1.0.35 update notes
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.35 update introduces two important features to the game: hardware cursor support and Simplified Chinese translation.

[list]
[*] [b]Hardware Cursor:[/b] The software cursor I was using moved with some lag compared to the system cursor. This issue was related to how Unreal Engine processes cursor location in the background, causing delays. I resolved the lag by switching from a software cursor to a hardware cursor. The mouse now uses the system's cursor location and is independent of FPS. Since mouse smoothing is no longer necessary, it has been removed from the settings menu.

[*] [b]Simplified Chinese Translation:[/b] Thanks to our friend [b]流浪猫Starycat[/b] from our Discord channel, Simplified Chinese has now been transitioned from machine translation to human translation, following the same process we used for German, French, and Italian. [i]If anyone would like to contribute by proofreading other languages, feel free to reach out to me![/i]

[*] [b]Pathfinding Optimization:[/b] In late-game scenarios where the city is surrounded by walls with all gates closed, FPS drops occurred when villagers had tasks outside the walls (like clearing areas, collecting resources, or constructing roads) due to the pathfinding process. A new algorithm has been developed to eliminate this issue.
[/list]

The full release of the game is just a few days away. I hope you’re satisfied with the game in its current state. Don’t forget to share your thoughts in reviews and provide feedback – it's very important to me! See you soon...

notes.title: Demo v1.0.34 update notes
notes.content:
Update v1.0.34 is a small update introducing new buildings to the full version of the game and enhancement cards related to those buildings. While the enhancement cards may appear in the demo, the newly added buildings remain locked.

[list]
[*] The full version now includes the tannery, armor workshop, and weapon workshop.
[*] Leather, leather armor, swords, bows, and arrows have been activated and can now be traded.
[*] Tooltip texts for the newly added buildings have been added.
[*] Enhancement cards for the new buildings and resources have been introduced.
[*] Several bugs related to enhancement cards have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Future of the Demo & Update v1.0.33
notes.content:
With only two weeks left until the game's release, I hope you're as excited as I am. Initially, I planned to close the demo a few weeks before launch. However, the demo has played a significant role in showcasing the game’s development and quality, providing a better experience than what Steam screenshots alone could convey. Because of this, I am leaning towards keeping the demo available indefinitely.

However, the demo offers 1-3 hours of gameplay with replayability. I worry that this length might satisfy players enough that they might lose the impulse to purchase the full game. Of course, this might be an unfounded fear, but my instincts still tell me to leave the demo open. As someone who shares the same taste in games as the demo players, I know that the satisfaction of managing a large population isn't experienced in the demo.

[i]That said, I do plan to slightly shorten the time it takes to finish the demo, which currently stretches up to 3 hours. For those who want more, the full version will be available soon. Additionally, I've added a system that allows you to transfer your saved demo games to the full version so you can pick up where you left off without losing progress.[/i]

I hope this will satisfy both those who prefer to try before buying and those who want to continue without losing the hours they've invested in the demo.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Snow Coverage Toggle: [/b]I’ve added a cosmetic option to toggle snow coverage on and off, as I believe the whiteness from snowfall might be uncomfortable for some players.
[*] [b]Demo Save Conversion: [/b]You can now continue playing your saved demo games in the full version. Additionally, features that were locked in the demo, like raid events in survival mode, can be toggled in the full version when you load your demo save for the first time.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Herbalist, Healer's Hut, and School[/b] are now locked in the demo.
[*] [b]Population Limit has been reduced from 60 to the original 50.[/b] Given the job slots freed up by the locked buildings, you'll still be able to allocate enough workers to other tasks.
[*] [b]Bear Caves and Wolf Dens are now disabled[/b] in the demo.
[/list]

Don’t forget to send feedback, report bugs, and recommend the game to your friends. See you in the Early Access release in two weeks!

notes.title: Demo v1.0.32 Update notes
notes.content:
Demo v1.0.32 is a update focusing on minor additions and optimizations. A few new settings were added, while some small bugs were fixed. Additionally, all resources and buildings currently in development have been removed from the lists. Only completed resources and buildings are now listed. As development progresses, these will appear in the game. I hope this will be the final update before release.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse Smoothing Setting:[/b] A setting was added for mouse smoothing, which averages the mouse's previous locations for smoother movement. By default, this setting is turned off, as it can cause the mouse to feel laggy, especially at low FPS. Players who prefer it can now enable it.

[*][b]Screenshot Mode:[/b] A screenshot mode was added, allowing players to hide the UI by pressing the F4 key.
 
[*][b]Credits:[/b] A credits menu was added, listing the contributors to the game.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Pathfinding for Long Distances:[/b] Improvements were made to the pathfinding algorithm for long distances. Previously, tasks at far distances were delayed due to pathfinding issues. However, challenges may still occur in scenarios where the village is surrounded by walls and a task outside the walls is located far from a gate.

[*][b]Stuttering in Consecutive Walking Commands:[/b] Fixed the issue where villagers would stutter when given consecutive walking commands.

[*][b]Predator Behavior Fix:[/b] Fixed the issue where predators would stutter when chasing villagers. Additionally, predators are now more likely to switch targets if a new villager enters their attack range while chasing.
[/list]

See you on October 2nd for the Early Access version!
Caner

notes.title: Demo v1.0.31 small patch notes
notes.content: The Demo v1.0.31 patch fixes a few bugs and makes improvements to the game while also updating the supported languages. Indicators and resources related to systems that have not yet been developed in the game have been hidden to avoid confusion. These resources will be listed as they are developed.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.30 Update Notes
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.30 update addresses several bugs and introduces numerous balance adjustments.

[h2]What's New[/h2]


[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/4c8d88f7ebd35f4144ab64296de7727643c62f1c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Improved Food Toolbar:[/b] Fixed a bug causing miscalculations in monthly food stock status as the game progresses. Added indicators for annual food requirements for livestock and villagers, as well as the amount of food produced and consumed in the previous year to better track food status.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/ddef7e6b87d238a238e9519f1b759e0956fbc02c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Idle Villagers and Laborers Tooltip:[/b] Added a tooltip to the occupations button showing the number of idle villagers and laborers when hovered over, eliminating the need to open the professions panel to view this information.
[/list]

[h2]Changes and Balances[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased the probability of traders selling livestock from 35% to 50%.
[*] Doubled the quantity of food sold by traders.
[*] Increased the gravedigger capacity in the cemetery from 2 to 3.

[*] Increased laborer capacity from 10 to 20.
[*] Increased builder capacity from 4 to 5.

[*] Increased forester capacity in the Forester's Hut from 3 to 4.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue from the last update where resources could not be transported to buildings under construction when a saved game was loaded.
[*] Fixed the road construction button not working when the game is paused.
[*] Corrected a typo that appeared when hovering over locked features in the new game creation window.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Enhancement Cards window where hovering over cards assigned to buildings or unassigned slots incorrectly showed "empty slot."
[*] Some codes reworked to prevent gravediggers, foresters, field farmers, livestock farmers, and waste collectors from getting stuck, particularly in the late stages of the game when traveling long distances. However, foresters and waste collectors may still occasionally get stuck until they select a different task.
[/list]


I hope this update satisfies you. If all goes well, this might be the final update before the game's release. I hope to release a new trailer soon and set the exact release date. Take care!

notes.title: Demo v1.0.29 Update Notes
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.29 update fixes some bugs and introduces several improvements.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The plain color sky in the main menu has been replaced with moving clouds and a blue sky.
[*] There was a flicker when tooltips appeared on screen due to the position of the previous tooltip. The new tooltip animation has fixed this issue.

[list]

See you soon, take care.

notes.title: Decorations and Parks Demo v1.0.28 Update Notes
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.28 update introduces flower gardens and parks to the game, along with several bug fixes and adjustments. Additionally, a mechanic allowing villagers to rest at parks has been added. Several other features not included in the demo have also been developed.

[h2]What's New in Demo?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/6d458e308a45731693e371fa5a170b1bf395faad.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Flower Gardens:[/b] These decorative structures increase the land value of a specific area. You can use small, medium, and large flower gardens to fill in unused tiles and enhance the land value of the surrounding area.

[*] [b]Parks:[/b] Like flower gardens, parks increase the land value of a specific area but are more effective. Parks are also used by villagers to rest during warm and hot weather. Building a park near workplaces can increase work efficiency by allowing villagers to rest closer to their jobs instead of traveling home.

[*] [b]Smokehouse:[/b] A building that dries and preserves meat and fish, significantly extending their shelf life.
[/list]

[h2]Features Not Included in the Demo:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Level 2 Town Center:[/b] The town center can be upgraded to level 2 when certain conditions are met.

[*] [b]Level 2 Houses:[/b] These houses offer advantages over level 1 buildings, including better durability, insulation, and slower decay rates.

[*] [b]Granary:[/b] A storage building necessary to keep grain and flour safe from rats.

[*] [b]Root Cellar:[/b] A storage building that significantly slows the decay rate of food resources.

[*] [b]Treasury House:[/b] A storage building that prevents gold from being stolen by villagers when kept in open storage.

[*] [b]Windmill:[/b] A structure that grinds grain into flour, which is then used for baking bread.

[*] [b]Bakery:[/b] Uses flour produced by the windmill to bake large quantities of bread. Bread has a short shelf life but is a preferred option for feeding a large population due to its fast production rate.

[*] [b]Cheese Maker:[/b] A building where milk, which has a short shelf life, is turned into cheese with a longer shelf life.

[*] [b]Sawmill:[/b] A production building that creates planks used in the construction of level 2 houses, ships, and furniture.

[*] [b]Market:[/b] A structure where commonly consumed resources are sold, generating varying amounts of gold depending on the product.

[*] [b]Rats:[/b] A mechanic where grain and flour stored outside the granary warehouse are targeted by rats, consuming these resources periodically.

[*] [b]Gold Theft:[/b] A mechanic where small amounts of gold stored outside the treasury are periodically stolen by villagers.
[/list]

For the early access release of the game, the remaining features to develop include fires, trade with neighboring villages, shipbuilding (partially developed), exploration missions, and the production of luxury resources. Once these are completed within the next 1-2 months, followed by a short promotional period, the game will be ready for launch(hopefully).

Keep sending your feedback, and see you soon!

notes.title: Demo v1.0.27 Update Notes
notes.content:
Demo v1.0.27 is an update that fixes several bugs and introduces a few minor changes. Additionally, the entire pathfinding algorithm has been optimized to be asynchronous, and caching algorithms for tasks have been improved to prevent excessive pathfinding load. These minor changes significantly reduce the load on the CPU's main core, especially with populations over 400.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/2c26fa9d0e016d3c9af86fd8b9d1fcaf6c342c2f.jpg[/img]
[*] The Town Center tiling has been increased from 5x5 to 6x6, allowing two houses to fit in each direction. This adjustment was necessary for a symmetrical layout.

[*] The amount of wood provided by trees has been increased by 10%.
 
[*] Saving the game before placing the town center at the start of a new game has been disabled. Games saved without placing the town center would display the game over screen when loaded.
 
[*] For optimization, physics-based ragdoll character deaths have been replaced with new death animations.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where foresters would get stuck in the task of taking fertilizer when there was no fertilizer in stock after building a compost yard in the village.

[*] Fixed an issue where hunters' arrows would hit the corners of buildings when shooting at deer from the edge of a building, causing the villager to get stuck in a shooting loop.
[/list]

See you in future updates!

notes.title: New Tips and Soundtracks - Demo v1.0.26 Update
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.26 update introduces new tips and soundtracks to the game. Additionally, a button displaying relevant tips has been added to the top panel of the building UI windows.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/6a1bdc6f2fba1eb2693c632cac8599424db6e96a.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Tips Button: [/b]To help you adapt to the game more quickly or optimize production, a tips button has been added to the building UIs. Tips related to the building are shown when you hover over this button. If you prefer not to see this button, you can disable it in the settings.

[*] [b]Alternative Food Types for Livestock: [/b]Previously, livestock consumed only grains. If production in the village was delayed or insufficient, there was little time to compensate, and the animals would die. Now, when there is a shortage of grains, livestock can consume greens and berries. However, they consume these resources at twice the rate of grains.

[*] [b]New soundtracks:[/b] Nine new background music tracks have been added, chosen to better fit the game's chill ambiance.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tasks:[/b] Personal inventory tasks such as fetching food for oneself or bringing food home will no longer interrupt other tasks. These tasks will now be queued like other tasks. This means that long-distance tasks like hunting or fishing will no longer be interrupted, except due to cold. Since the fetching food task is queued, when a villager runs out of food in their inventory, they will automatically consume food from their home inventory or the nearest storage one by one until they restock their inventory.
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fog of War:[/b] The fog of war system has been reworked for better performance with high populations.
 
[*] [b]Movement System:[/b] With the introduction of raiding mechanics, a collision detection system was necessary to prevent units from overlapping. To avoid FPS issues with high unit counts, the movement system has been reworked for the third time to support multithreading. Reworks are always prone to bugs. If you encounter any issues, please report them.
[/list]

[h2]Feature deveoplments(Not in the Demo):[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Raiding Mechanics:[/b] Most of the raiding mechanics have been developed. The barracks, archer range buildings, and training system are complete. Only balancing and testing remain. This has been the most challenging stage so far. Playtests may be conducted for the testing phase in the future.
[/list]

See you in future updates.
The Catalyst Crew

notes.title: Micro-Management UI Tools
notes.content:
Demo v1.0.25 introduces a variety of tools for micro-management and game tracking, along with new settings, shortcut keys, and refactored optimizations in background mechanics.

[h1]New UI Tools[/h1]
[h2]Resource Logistics Records[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/2460c7812f1d9005dd9751812380f2627e466f4a.jpg[/img]
Records now track which resources are transported from which buildings to which buildings, and by whom, for up to 4 years. This allows players to see the extent of resource transfers between buildings. To access logistics records, click on the resource logistics section in the building management panels. In the logistics interface, players can view transfers of all resources or specific resources over a period ranging from 6 months to 4 years.

[h2]Efficiency Ledger[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/4f5dad95414e7576c4c8970f0195387e50f8b044.jpg[/img]
Every 5 seconds (1 game day), the tasks performed by workers are recorded. These records are kept for up to 1 game year, allowing players to see the average task distribution of workers in production buildings via the production records section. Hovering over any worker in the worker list shows the task distribution for that worker only. This tool helps players see how much time workers spend working, commuting, and transporting or storing resources, allowing for better planning.

[h2]Yearly Production[/h2]
Records of total outputs for production buildings are kept for up to the past 10 years. These records can be viewed in the production records section of the building interfaces.

[h2]Building List[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/0b01656b1ee5c2798a56f09f43bb1db50c7a14de.jpg[/img]
A building list button has been added to the main management section. With this interface, players can view all buildings on a single page and see their details collectively. For example, the capacity used for storages, the accumulated water for wells, and production records for production buildings can be accessed from this interface. Players can also search for specific buildings or filter by category. Clicking on any building takes the player to that building and opens its management panel.

[h2]Building Search[/h2]
A building search shortcut has been added to the F3 key, allowing players to quickly find a building on the map. As soon as the player starts typing a building name after pressing F3, buildings matching the entered text are highlighted on the map. Pressing Enter, ESC, or clicking elsewhere automatically closes the search box.

[h2]Villager List[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/98d70748061e3bc6d15368dc0443bf222228b6c2.png[/img]
An interface listing all living villagers has been added to the game. In this interface, players can search for villagers by name, profession, gender, and age. The interface provides information on the name, gender, age, profession, and current task of each villager. Clicking on any villager in the list takes the player to that villager.

[h2]Manage Stored Resources[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43886373/f46dfe7419d2131892331e479dac20200030fdad.jpg[/img]
A new tool has been added to designate which products will be stored in storages. In the interface of storage buildings, you can open the manage stored resources panel in the management section to collectively ban, allow, or set the desired stock amount for products.

[h2]Other additions[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Contrast, Saturation, White Balance, and Gamma Adjustment:[/b] The game's contrast has been increased by 6%. Additionally, players can now adjust contrast, saturation, white balance, and gamma settings to their preference via the settings.

[*] [b]Quick Save Shortcut:[/b] A quick save key has been added to the F5 key. With this shortcut, the game is saved over the last saved name if it exists, or over the first auto-save slot if it does not, without entering the menu.

[*] [b]Arrows Colliding with Buildings:[/b] Arrows now collide with and stick to buildings instead of passing through them. Archers and hunters now move around buildings until they have a clear line of sight to their target.

[*] [b]Automatic Deletion of Dead Bodies:[/b] Uncollected dead bodies are automatically deleted after a long time. This feature was added to prevent bugged bodies from remaining in place throughout the game.

[*] [b]Hostile Vision Test:[/b] Predatory animals and enemies now check if there are obstacles like defense walls or mountains blocking their line of sight when entering each other's vision radius. Buildings are an exception in this check to avoid affecting the game's playability.

[*] [b]Target Reachability Test:[/b] With the addition of defense walls, a reachability test is performed to check if walls block access to the points villagers and units want to reach. This test is performed at the start of all tasks, eliminating bugs such as building on inaccessible islands.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Livestock Sale Probability:[/b] If livestock is being purchased for the first time in the village, the likelihood of traders bringing livestock is doubled. After the first livestock purchase, this rate returns to its original 30%.

[*] [b]Trader Changes:[/b] The variety of products purchased by traders has been increased. Additionally, the purchase and sale volume of some resources with surplus production, such as animal hides, has been increased.

[*] [b]Event Log Location Changed:[/b] Event log notifications have been moved from the left side of the screen to the bottom right corner.
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]NavMesh Area Size Optimization:[/b] The walkable area size is dynamically adjusted based on the map size, speeding up navigation creation on small and medium maps and reducing CPU load during map startup.

[*] [b]Navigation and Walking Code Refactor:[/b] To compensate for the extra CPU load caused by the reachability test, walking mechanics have been refactored for better optimization. The new codes have not been thoroughly tested, so if you encounter any bugs related to walking or reaching targets, please report them.

[*] [b]Multithreaded Environment Check:[/b] Vision tests and reachability tests in environment checks add extra load to the main thread. Therefore, a large portion of vision and environment checks has been offloaded to other threads. This optimization is aimed at preventing significant performance drops when the population reaches levels of 400-500. Since threaded operations can often cause crashes, please report any crashes you encounter.
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the compost yard close button not working.
[*] Fixed field workers' experience not affecting product output.
[*] Fixed the issue of dead animals not being removed sometimes from the livestock.
[*] Some spelling errors have been fixed.
[/list]

I am very satisfied with the new tools, and I hope you will be too. Please do not hesitate to provide feedback. See you in future updates..

notes.title: Predator update - Demo v1.0.24
notes.content:
Demo v1.0.24 predator update introduces bear caves and wolf dens to the game. These predators pose threats to villagers across different seasons. It's enabled by default in the Survival preset but can be turned off or increased in quantity in new game settings. Bear caves and wolf dens can be destroyed by villagers.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Bear caves: [/b]There are 2 bears residing in bear caves, and bears are visible except in the winter season.
[*] [b]Wolf dens:[/b] There are 3 wolves in wolf dens, and wolves appear only during the winter months.
[/list]

Predators emerge around caves and dens in specific seasons. They attack any villagers they notice nearby. When villagers spot a predator, they switch to attack mode and engage the predator. If a villager's health drops below a certain percentage, they will run to a nearby building to avoid death. The predator chases the villager until it kills them. If it sees another target closer during the chase, it will switch its focus to that new target. This scenario usually ends with the predator reaching the village and being killed by other villagers. Villager deaths are rare.

Villagers can also be directed to attack a predator or its den directly. In this case, the villager attacks the target until death. Inside the animal dens, there can always be one or several animals that haven't come out yet. When you attack the dens, the animals emerge. This situation poses an increased threat to the villagers. In this scenario, villager deaths usually occur.

Take care and see you in future updates.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.23 Update Notes
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.23 update brings several UI additions and optimizations to the game. Additionally, defense walls and gates, building hitpoints, and building repairing have been added, but will not available in the demo. Since there will be no attacks on the village in the demo, these features will only be visible on the UI.

It is more appropriate to omit the developments that are outside the scope of the Demo from this article since the this new is only related to the Demo.

[h2]UI Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]You no longer need to click on a building construction to see its progress. By hovering your mouse over it, you can see what process is being carried out, the construction progress, and the builders assigned to that task.

[*]A tooltip has been added when hovering over resources in the trading list with a merchant. This tooltip shows how much the merchant is buying or selling that resource, how much you can buy or sell, and how much stock you have in your village's depots, making the numbers easier to understand.

[*]In the demo's construction menu, texts saying "locked" have now been replaced with "under development" or "demo." This change makes it clearer which buildings can be constructed in demo.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The building demolition animation effect has been changed. The previous animation was buildings breaking apart and scattering, which, while visually appealing, frequently encountered visual bugs and was not optimized for performance. Anticipating that the inclusion of natural disasters like earthquakes would cause FPS drops due to multiple houses collapsing simultaneously, it was replaced with a simpler animation.
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]The occlusion technique used to prevent rendering of small objects has been optimized. The load on the CPU has been reduced, and FPS has been made more stable at distant camera views.

[*]The LODs for field crops have been further optimized.
[/list]

Looking forward to seeing you in future updates. Take good care of yourself.

notes.title: Education Update - Demo v1.0.22
notes.content:
With the Demo v1.0.22 update, an education system has been introduced to the game. The school building, the teacher profession, and cards related to school enhancements have been added. Additionally, several UI updates and bug fixes were made.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]School:[/b]Villagers of learning age will receive education in the school until they become adults. Educated villagers specialize faster in their jobs, reach higher levels, and have fewer work accidents.

[*][b]Teachers:[/b]Teachers have been added to the game along with the school. Currently, a maximum of 2 teachers can work in a school.

[*][b]Education-related enhancement cards:[/b]Enhancement cards that increase the capacity of the school and the speed of learning in the school have been added.

[*][b]UI updates:[/b]More information is displayed when you hover over buildings such as production buildings, storages, and water wells. For example, when you hover over production buildings, it shows the current production progress in the building. In the storage, it shows the fill rate of the storage.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Broken villager UI ID numbers have been fixed.

[*]The system that detects whether the mouse is over a UI has been improved. Functions like clicking on something and zooming were locked until pressing ESC when a UI window was closed. The new system aims to prevent this. If anyone still encounters this issue, it would be very helpful to mention it in the bug reports.
[/list]

It seems we are slowly approaching the final versions of the demo version. The next updates look like they will be on raid mechanics and ship production. Since these won't be in the demo, there might not be new content for the demo for a few weeks. Until then, enjoy the game!

notes.title: Livestock Update - Demo v1.0.21
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.21 update introduces the livestock system to the game, activating all the necessary resources for the livestock system as well.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

Livestock consumes grains and water, producing various resources along with a certain amount of waste.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[/list]

notes.title: Streamer Mode - Demo v1.0.20 Update
notes.content:
Demo v1.0.20 update is a small update that adds 5 new music tracks to the game and includes a streamer mode setting for streamers.

There were already 17 tracks in the game. All of this music was purchased from a music and sound effects store that is one of the most trusted in its field. When sellers put their music on the market, they indicate whether it has a YouTube content ID. I made sure to purchase these 17 tracks without YouTube content ID.

In the initial versions of the demo, despite all of them claiming not to have a content ID, it turned out to have one, so I removed that track. However, it seems that one of the seller of some of these tracks later decided to obtain a content ID, leading to revenue sharing for youtubers in new videos as well as old ones.

This situation is detrimental to both the efforts of streamers and the promotional opportunities of the game. Therefore, I had to add the 5 tracks I composed and include the streamer mode setting in the game.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Main menu music has been replaced with a new one.
[*]Four background music tracks for the game have been added. The length of the background music has reached approximately 1 hour. In streamer mode, the background music length is 14 minutes.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash error caused by a rare occurrence of the trading dock worker when the game was loading.
[/list]

[h2]What's Coming Next?[/h2]
[list]
[*]I wanted to bring the streamer mode with the livestock update, but foreseeing that it would take another 5-6 days, I decided to bring the streamer mode first. Our next update will introduce new resources with the livestock.

Until then, enjoy the demo.
