notes.title: Illnesses and Injuries - Demo v1.0.18 Update Notes
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.18 update brings mild illnesses, work accidents, and resulting injuries to the game. It introduces the necessary buildings and resources for the treatment of these diseases. Additionally, it includes a graphic updates and fixes some bugs.

[h2]New Buildings[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Herbalist:[/b] Herbalists in this building produce herbal medicines using herbs and medical roots to cure the villager illnesses.
[*] [b]Healer's Hut:[/b] While not all diseases require inpatient treatment, injuries from work accidents and serious illnesses often do. While villagers can recover on their own, inpatient treatment speeds up the healing process and consumes fewer resources.
[/list]

[h2]New Resources[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Herbs:[/b] Used in the production of herbal medicines, they can spawn on the map or be grown in farm fields.
[*] [b]Medical Roots:[/b] Also used in the production of herbal medicines, they can spawn on the map or be grown in farm fields.
[*] [b]Herbal Medicines: [/b]Used for treating villagers in the healer's hut, they can also be used outside the healer's hut to maintain the health of villagers. When there are no herbal medicines in the village storages, villagers are at increased risk of common illnesses and take longer to recover.
[/list]
[i]*Medical roots and herbs are not available on the map in saved games. You need to start a new game to get them on the map. However, you can grow them in farm fields on your previously saved games[/i]

[h2]Diseases and Disabilities[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Common Cold: [/b]Villagers who feel cold during winter are at risk of common cold. While it doesn't require inpatient treatment, it reduces work efficiency by 30%.
[*] [b]Bone Fracture:[/b] An injury resulting from a work accident that requires inpatient treatment.
[*] [b]Burn:[/b] Can occur in accidents at workplaces with fire or during fires (not yet implemented to game). Although it requires inpatient treatment, the treatment time is short.
[*] [b]Open Wound: [/b]Another injury resulting from work accidents that requires inpatient treatment.
[/list]
[i]*Although there are only a few illnesses and injuries at the moment, the variety will increase as the game balances out. To avoid overwhelming players in the first few years, the frequency of illnesses and injuries is low at the beginning, gradually transitioning to normal frequency from the fourth year onwards.[/i]

[h2]Enhancement Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhancement cards for herbs, medical roots, and herbal medicines have been added.
[*] Production speed cards for herbal medicines have been added.
[*] Cards for reducing illness damage and increasing healing speed for the healer's hut have been added.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Saturation increased by 7% for livelier colors.
[*] Grass density increased, and render distance extended so it can be visible even when zoomed out.
[*] Resources required to build the town center are now included in the storage cart at the beginning of the game.
[*] Possibility for constructing houses and basic production buildings without building the town center. 
[*] Construction speed of level 1 houses increased by 30%.
[*] Warning sign removed when resource indicators in the top right corner show zero.
[*] Storage cart now blocks the tile it occupies, preventing building on top of it until it disappears.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed listing of removed resources in storages and UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where resources couldn't be selected when changing a resource in one of the resource indicators in the top right corner.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing multiple trading docks to be built.
[/list]

Hope to see you in future updates.

notes.title: Thank you for the 15k wishlist - Devlog 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you're all doing well!

This is is the first devlog post for Settlements Rising, and it's also my first devlog post on Steam ever. I wanted to thank you for the 15,000 wishlists. Also, if anyone is interested, I'd like to share some statistics about the game.

[h2]Before the demo[/h2]
I started developing the game in November 2022. Initially, I didn't have such a detailed game in mind, of course. The goal was to create a game with enough content that I could release within 1-1.5 years. I started developing it alone, but I was thinking of involving a few friends in the project along the way, but right now I'm still the only one. So, we can say this product is the work of a single person. Apart from music and sound effects, I'm trying to create all the assets myself. One of the reasons for the game's low poly style can be attributed to this.

I launched the game's Steam page to everyone on April 1st. I quickly added a trailer, but at that point, there was hardly any interest in the game, so I started to lose hope a bit, I must admit. The game lacked the visual appeal and excitement that could make it go viral on social media, so my opportunity to promote the game before the demo was very weak. I focused more on creating a great demo than on marketing. 

I tried my best to make the demo feel as nice as possible, and in the process it went from being a game that could be made in 1-1.5 years to a more detailed and nice game, and I'm happy about that.

[h2]After the Demo[/h2]
Knowing that without a demo game can't be effectively marketed, I knew a good demo was crucial for marketing. I worked hard to make sure the demo had at least 45 minutes of content and was polished enough not to lose the player in the first few minutes. Also, since receiving feedback was one of the main goals of releasing the demo, I had added sections in the game where you could send feedback. I'm very grateful for having done that. I released the demo on November 6, 2023, and by then, we had 600 wishlists.

The wishlist increase, which was between 0-1 per day before the demo's release, jumped to 400-500 after the demo for several days. The demo received incredible attention and was tried out by many content creators in a short time. Other than a bug that caused FPS drops in the early versions of the demo, there weren't many issues that bothered me. With quickly integrating the feedback, the demo reached high levels of quality.

As of today, we have reached 15,000 wishlists, and I want to thank the 16k+ people who played the demo for your interest. The success of the demo is thanks to you and the feedback you sent!

[h2]Statistics for the Curious[/h2]
[list]
[*]15k: Wishlists
[*]8.01: Average rating you gave to the demo out of 10 <3
[*]452: Number of votes
[*]46m: Median demo playtime
[*]1h 35m: Average demo playtime
[*]142: Feedback forms filled out
[*]16k: Demo players
[*]5.12: New games per demo player
[*]390k: Total buildings built
[*]132k: Immigrated villagers
[*]211k: Babies born
[*]82k: Villagers died
[*]10k: Number of saved games
[*]5.5k: Number of players reaching 50 population
[/list]

I'm excited along with those who are excited about the game. I hope I've been able to meet your expectations and continue to do so with future updates. An update bringing a illnesses and injuries to the game will be released in the next 2-4 days, I'll also let you know about that.

Until the next devlogs, take care!
Caner

notes.title: Navigation update Demo v1.0.17
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.17 update is a navigation update in the game where villagers prefer roads for walking. Additionally, it includes several tips and notifications.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Navigation Update:[/b] In previous versions, villagers preferred the shortest path to their destination. Now, villagers prefer walking along paths. In this version, paths do not affect the walking speed of villagers, but this could be addressed with a stone road update.
[*][b]New Tip Texts:[/b] Several tip texts related to the trading system have been added.
[*][b]Food Production Notification: [/b]A notification has been added for new players, directing them to construct a food production building immediately after producing houses for homeless villagers.
[*][b]Villager Profile Pictures:[/b] Three different profile pictures have been added for villagers of different ages: baby, child, adult, and elderly.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Graphic adjustments have been made to have puddles of water on the ground when it rains.
[*]When a water well is built, it will now start with a reserve of 50 units of water.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where when a villager was given an order to go somewhere, if another order was given to a different place before reaching the destination, the villager would wait to complete the first order. Now, if a walking order is in progress and a second order is given, the first order will be canceled, and they will execute the last order.
[/list]

See you in future updates..

notes.title: Trading update - Demo v1.0.6
notes.content:
With the Demo v1.0.6 update, trading system has been introduced to the game. Since gold is used in the trading system, gold, gold ore, and gold production have also become active. Additionally, due to the increasing number of professions, the population limit in the demo has been raised from 50 to 60.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Trading dock: [/b]Merchants come to the trading dock at certain intervals. When merchants come, they carry a certain amount of resources to sell and some gold to buy. Merchants can buy as much product as their money allows. When you buy something from them, they earn money, which they can use to buy resources from you in that same trade. Merchants stay at the dock for a few minutes, and if there's no trade until their time is up, they leave. If you have no intention of trading with a merchant, you can also ask them to leave immediately.

[*][b]Dock workers:[/b] To sell things to merchants at the trading dock, the products must be available in the dock's storage. Dock workers collect the specified amount of products you've designated for sale from village storages and transport them to the dock's storage. Additionally, they also transport the resources you've bought from merchants from the dock's storage to the village storages.

[*][b]Gold Ore:[/b] Gold ore deposits can now be found in the foothills after generating the map. Gold ore can be collected by miners and used for gold production. Gold ore will be available in new maps generated with Demo v.1.0.6; maps from previous versions cannot be regenerated.

[*][b]Gold:[/b] Gold can be obtained by smelting gold ore in the smeltery or through trade. Although gold is only used for trade in these versions, in later stages, it can be used for luxury resource production and as wages in various professions.

[*]Enhancement cards related to gold, gold ore, and their production have been added.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pottery, glass jars, and sand have been removed from resources. They will be replaced with different resources.
[*]The population upper limit has been increased from 50 to 60.
[*]Fish accumulated in the fishing hut were not being moved to the storages until the quantity reached 100. Now, if there are more than 50 fish in the fishing hut's storage, an available fisher will move them to the storages.
[*]To increase the efficiency of the miners, and to avoid the need for laborers to be busy picking up the resources as collected resources fall to the ground, the resources collected by the miners go directly to the storage of the miner's hut.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where workers were not working for clothing production(even if fiber was available) in the weaver building when animal hide was not available in any of storages.
[*]Several spelling errors in English have been corrected.
[/list]

The trade system has a direct impact on the balancing of the game, so bug reports and feedback on balancing are very important.

See you in the new updates.

notes.title: Crop Field Update - Demo v1.0.15
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.15 update brings crop fields and field farmers to the game. It also introduces a few new enhancement cards.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Crop field:[/b] The crop field is a place where some resources used in food or equipment production can be grown. Crops require labor, water, and fertilizer, and field farmers meet these needs for the crops. Each crop has its own growth rate and maturation time. Currently, up to 4 crops can be queued in a cycle in the fields. It is built with a minimum of 1 unit area and a maximum of 9 unit areas, with 1 unit area being 4x4 tiles in size. One farmer can work for one unit area in the fields. There are currently a few growable plants in the game, but the variety will increase as it is updated.

[*][b]Enhancement cards:[/b] Enhancement cards that provide adult villagers, enhance the yield or speed of fields have been added.

[*]A warning for storage after all storages being almost full in the village has been added.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The name of the jute plant has been changed to fiber plant, and jute has been changed to fiber for better understanding.
[/list]

See you in future updates.

notes.title: Demo v1.0.14 update notes
notes.content:
The demo 1.0.14 update is a small update that addresses several issues and adds a few new sounds.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New sound effects:[/b] Added wheel sounds for wheelbarrows and fire sounds for the wood charcoal kiln. Additionally, the sawing sound during construction, as well as the sounds for waste collection and pouring, have been replaced with new ones.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Changes to the navigation system:[/b] Villagers can no longer pass through buildings and fences. Technically, in previous versions, areas covered by buildings and fences were accessible but considered costly and undesirable areas to prevent villagers from getting stuck in unmapped locations. However, this sometimes caused issues where villagers moved back and forth in these areas and struggled to reach their destination. From this moment, these areas are now completely inaccessible. An algorithm has also been added to transport villagers born in these areas to the nearest walkable position. Since the new system has not been extensively tested, please report any errors you encounter.

[*]In storage areas, a new storage alignment algorithm has been developed to prevent the repositioning of all items when a villager stores or takes a resource. Updates to a storage will no longer change the position of all items.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a few incorrect language translations in Chinese.
[*]Resolved the issue where a villager would get stuck when taking firewood from the storage when their inventory was full.
[*]Fixed the crash issue for players who had played very early versions of the game when clicking on the enhancement card selection in the new game menu. However, this update removes old cards from the game, so you won't be able to see previously saved cards in this version.
[/list]

See you in future updates.

notes.title: Land Value Update Demo v1.0.13
notes.content:
With Demo v1.0.13, the land value mechanic has been added to the game.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Land value:[/b] Some buildings can now increase or decrease the land value up to a certain distance. For example, buildings that create noise and pollution decrease the land value, while buildings such as the town centre and water wells increase the land value. The land value of the house where the villagers live affects their happiness and indirectly their work rate. The land value mechanic can be switched off and on in the new game settings.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the immigration system not working when loading a saved game for the first time.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v.1.0.12 update notes
notes.content:
The Demo v.1.0.12 update fixes a few bugs and adds optimization for laborers and the use of fertilizer in forestry.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fertilizer can now be used on demand in forestry. Trees grow 50% faster when fertilizer use is active. For this version, for every 100 trees, 8 fertilizers are consumed in 1 game year.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Laborers' tasks for clearing trees and stones have been optimized. Now, when cutting trees or breaking stones, the task will no longer be canceled and left unfinished except in emergencies. Also, the oldest specified areas will be prioritized instead of the most recently specified areas.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the situation where trees could not grow enough in forestry.

[*]Automatic debugging has been added to prevent villagers' houses from not being updated when some houses are destroyed, causing the game to freeze or villagers to wander outside.

[*]In case of equipment shortage, when a new equipment is produced, all villagers who need that equipment won't leave their jobs and come to takee equipment anymore. As many villagers as the equipment produced will leave their jobs and come to buy equipment.

[*]Fixed the cemetery construction animation not appearing and the demolition sound not sounding when demolishing.
[/list]

notes.title: Cemetery Update - Demo v1.0.11
notes.content:
With the Demo v1.0.11 update, cemeteries have been added to the game. Along with several crucial bug fixes, an improvement has been made to the notification system.

[h2]What's New[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Cemetery: [/b]A place for burying deceased villagers with a capacity of 32. Up to 2 gravediggers can work. Deceased villagers cause unrest in the surrounding area and remain without removal for an extended period. Gravediggers transport the dead bodies to the cemetery for burial. Buried bodies  clear space in the cemetery after approximately 10 in-game years.

[*][b]Smeltery Required Notification:[/b] A notification has been added when the smeltery is not built despite the blacksmith being constructed. People mistakenly think iron ore is used instead of iron. It is now clear that processed iron is required for tool production.

[*][b]New Happiness Parameter - Events: [/b]An environmental parameter, considering events like death and natural disasters, has been added when calculating villagers' happiness.

[*]Shortcut CTRL+LMB added to reopen the build menu after placing a building.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Villagers can consume stored food in warehouses until they obtain food from depots when hungry, without having food in their homes or inventories. This prevents them from losing health while on the road.

[*]Automatic closing and reopening of all notifications have been disabled. Now, a warning notification remains open until the situation is resolved. The irritation of frequently reopening has been eliminated.

[*]The button for renaming villagers has been moved from under the interface to the upper right, making it clearer that names can be changed.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where a certain percentage of resources would be added to the stock when uncommon or rare resource cards were used in the first card selection.

[*]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when searching for a home for homeless villagers after a house was demolished.

[*]Fixed a bug where the waste collector would get stuck at the location of the demolished house when there was waste to be collected at that location.

[*]Several translation errors were fixed.
[/list]

See you with the new updates.
The Catalyst Crew

notes.title: UI Improvements - Demo v1.0.10
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.10 update brings several UI improvements that will make the player's job easier.

[h2]What's New[/h2]
[list]
[*]New season indicator: The season indicator has been changed to be clearer and take up less space. The season, date and temperature are now displayed together. You can also hover over the season indicator to see date details and gameplay time.

[*]Replaceable resource stock indicators: With the shrinking of the season indicator, more resource indicators have been added to the right of the indicator. You can also CTRL+click on these resources to replace them with another resource of your choice. These changes are saved for all your games.

[*]Added sections in the production and gathering buildings where you can set global storage limits. Now, when setting a storage limit for a resource, you can set it or see the limit directly from the production building UI instead of opening the resources menu.

[*]Storage limit reached indicators: When a resource reaches the global storage limit you have set, an icons will ve appear above the buildings that produce that product. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the local storage limit set in the open storage was removed in loaded games. 
[/list]

The next update will add cemetery or selective storage building where you can store only the resources of your choice to the game.

Enjoy the game

notes.title: Compost yard and waste collectors - Demo v1.0.9 Update notes
notes.content:
With the Demo v1.0.9 update, waste and compost yard are added to the game. Additionally, self-debuging algorithms are expanded, and an option to select the DirectX version is added.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Compost Yard:[/b] The Compost yard is where waste is collected in piles and fertilizers are produced through the fertilization method.

[*][b]Waste collectors: [/b]Houses produce a total of 10 stacks of waste in approximately 2.5 in-game years, and this waste needs to be collected. When a certain amount of waste accumulates, waste collectors go to these houses with wheelbarrows, collect the waste, and pile it up in the compost yard. Accumulating waste in houses without being collected makes villagers unhappy.

[*][b]DirectX12[/b] is now the default DirectX version. An option has been added in the settings for those experiencing performance issues to choose between dx11 and dx12. The game needs to be restarted for the DirectX selection to take effect.

[*][b]Italian translation update.[/b] Many thanks to our friend xs4nd3r (Alessandro) for volunteering corrections for Italian translations.

[*]Self-debugging algorithms are added for bugs that may occur in the take raw resources task in production buildings, fishing boats, and deer roaming.

In the next few updates, any bugs that may have resulted from this update will be fixed. A new top UI will be designed. Cemetery system will be added.

Enjoy your game!
Caner
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.8 Hotfix
notes.content:
Version 1.0.8 of the demo fixes a few issues.

[list]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.7 Update Notes
notes.content:
The version 1.0.7 update for the demo focuses on improving the user interface. It adds some small informative elements to better guide the player during their initial gameplay.

notes.title: Charcoal Kiln - Demo v1.0.6
notes.content:
Charcoal Kiln - Demo v1.0.6 Update Notes

With the Demo v1.0.6 version, the game now includes a wood charcoal furnace. You can use wood charcoal in production buildings instead of regular coal. Additionally, some adjustments have been made to the gameplay, and certain issues have been resolved.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Charcoal Kiln A production building that works with a maximum of 2 charcoal producers, turning wood into charcoal. It is efficient to build it next to the blacksmith and foundry.
[*]Storage and transport models for iron, iron ore, coal, and charcoal have been added.
[*]Icons specific to each season have been added for better understanding of the season indicator.
[*]The fishing hut can no longer be built when there are no accessible fish around. This prevents the construction of fishing huts in lakes without fish.  Furthers more, when the fishing hut is built, it automatically determines the focus area by centering around the nearest fish source.
[*]Road construction indicators are now more visible in the presence of snow to better represent winter.
[*] Now, when you hover over villagers, a text appears indicating not only their name and job but also the task they are currently performing.
[*]A French translation update has been made. Many thanks to my friend Cédric Gauché (CdriX) for volunteering to translate into French, and to Noah (Chamëleon TBN) for volunteering and assisting in many areas including German translations.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Several translation errors in some languages have been fixed.
[*]Deer and villagers getting stuck and moving left and right in place have been fixed. Deer getting stuck was also locking hunters, so that issue has also been resolved.
[*]The task of carrying water to the house causing villagers to get stuck when the water well is far away has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Optimization Update Demo V1.0.5
notes.content: Demo v1.0.5 update fixes a bug that causes aperformance drop over time when vsync and FPS limit is not used in the game. The task of clearing areas of road constructions passing through trees or rocks was causing the pool to refill at high speeds without allowing deleting older tasks, leading to excessive filling of the pool and creating a bottleneck on the CPU. This issue has been resolved. In addition to this, an option to switch FPS indicator on/off has been added to options.

notes.title: Demo V1.0.4 update
notes.content:
Demo V1.0.4 minor update includes 1 new game setting, 1 edit and 1 bug fix.

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added turning off enhancement cards to new game settings. Considered for those who want to play without development cards.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustment[/h2]
[list]
[*] The button showing the annual production amounts of production buildings has been moved to the header of the interface. This change was made due to people not noticing this feature.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Gatherer's hut would deactivate when built until the player changed the number of workers inside.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo V1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
In the Demo 1.0.3 update, UI additions, several gameplay adjustments, and bug fixes were continued.

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*]In snowy weather, it was challenging to see the focus areas of buildings when the ground was white. Now, when the ground reaches a certain amount of snow, the area indicators, which were yellow, turn black.
[*]In the UIs of warehouses and villagers, when you hover over resources, it now shows how many days until they decay or the remaining durability in days.
[*]A tracking system was developed to better monitor all stored, on-ground, and in-transfer resources. The resource indicators are now more accurate.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Warnings about homeless villagers and insufficient housing start showing after the town center is built. Clicking on warnings that appear before building the town center used to prevent building houses. This adjustment was made to avoid confusion for players.
[*]The red-colored warning in the resource management and building management buttons has been made more prominent.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Ein Problem wurde behoben, bei dem das Schließen des Panels, das durch Anklicken eines Dorfbewohners mit ESC und anschließendem erneuten Drücken von ESC geöffnet wurde, nicht das Pausenmenü öffnete.
[*]Resolved the problem where right-clicking to move a villager did not stop the camera rotation and movement. This feature will make more sense when aligning multi-unit selection in one direction.
[*]Fixed the issue where the profile of a villager wouldn't open when clicked while the game was paused.
[*]Added 75 FPS to the FPS limit options, and fixed the issue where the limit selection wasn't immediately active.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo V1.0.2 - A Better Experience for New Players
notes.content:
The Demo v1.0.2 update makes several UI additions to better guide new players and fixes a few errors.

[h2]Additions made:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now, when you hover over buildings, the meanings of the icons on them are displayed.
[*] In the early stages of the game, a notification has been added to remind you to build a warehouse.
[/list]

[h2]Changes made:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Coal gathering speed has been increased by 33%.
[*] In chill new game presed, mild weather is now set as the default. Freeze damage has been removed in the mild weather option.
[*] The frequency of some informative messages has been increased from 5 minutes to 8 minutes.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The issue where the music stops when the game window loses focus in windowed mode has been fixed.
[*] When buildings are placed directly on top of small rocks, the excessively long time it takes for those rocks to break has been fixed.
[*] Villagers' warmth dropping when they enter certain production buildings despite the weather being warm has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Worker assignment update Demo - v1.0.1
notes.content:
In this small update, a few additions have been made to improve the player experience and a bug that was causing FPS issues has been fixed. 

[h2]Improvements made[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now vacant occupations can be automatically filled from workers. This is also offered as a choice. In the occupations management panel, players can turn off the filling of vacant jobs from workers if they wish.

[*] When increasing the number of workers assigned through the production building, a small window will show the number of idle people and the number of workers if they are using them.

[*] When you start the game, when you hover over the resources before placing the town center, their names and resource amounts are now displayed.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where overlapping resources while building a road would cause severe FPS drops until the road was finished.

[*] Fixed an issue where starting with the spacebar at the start of the game would cause the game to start paused.

[*] Fixed the deer resource indicator not resizing when the game paused.

[*] Fixed a translation bug in Chinese.
[/list]
